abstract: A 12-year-old female patient (Miss E.Y.) suffering from abdominal tumor was proved to be a dispermic or generalized chimera. Ninety-two percent of her red cells were group A1, the first locus of phosphoglucomutase (PGM1) 1A, 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (PGD) AC and 8% of them were group B, PGM1 1A-2A, PGD A. Ninety cells out of one hundred and ten cultured lymphocytes were normal 46 XY and 20 cells were normal 46 XX. She secreted B and H substances at normal secretor range and a small amount of A substance in her saliva. The A-transferase level found in her serum was about 40% of those of group A1 individuals. The B-transferase level was in the normal range. Her hairs had B antigen and PGM1 phenotype of their root cells was 1A-2A. The cells of hair root were X chromatin-positive and Y body-negative. Her nails had lesser A antigen and potent B antigen. Major epithelial cells (approximately 75%) of her buccal mucosa expressed B antigen and minor cells expressed A antigen. The proportion of the X chromatin-positive buccal cells (15%) was lower than those in normal females (20-25%) and that of Y body-positive buccal cells (10%) was higher than those in normal females (0-3%). The surgically resected abdominal tumor was her right uterine adnexa with malignant transformation, the histological diagnosis of which was dysgerminoma. The tumor cell nest and the epithelial cells of ductal structure expressed A antigen, whereas the endothelial cells of blood vessels expressed B antigen. These findings showed that the proband's body cells arose from the two cell lines, one carrying A1 gene had normal 46 XY male karyotype and another carrying B gene had normal 46 XX female karyotype, and suggested that her right gonad which was contributed by the former cell line had a malignancy in the presence of Y chromosome.
abstract_ja: 腹部腫瘤を有する12歳女性(E.Y.)は、二精子性または全身性キメラであることが判明した。赤血球の92%は血液型A1、ホスホグルコムターゼ(PGM1) 1A、6-ホスホグルコン酸脱水素酵素(PGD) ACであり、8%は血液型B、PGM1 1A-2A、PGD Aであった。培養リンパ球110個のうち90個は正常な46XY、20個は正常な46XXであった。唾液中のB物質とH物質は正常な分泌型の範囲で分泌され、A物質はわずかに分泌されていた。血清中のA転移酵素レベルは、A1型個体の約40%であった。B転移酵素レベルは正常範囲内であった。毛髪にはB抗原があり、毛根細胞のPGM1表現型は1A-2Aであった。毛根細胞はX染色体陽性、Y小体陰性であった。爪ではA抗原が少なく、B抗原が強く認められた。頬粘膜の主要な上皮細胞(約75%)はB抗原を発現し、少数の細胞はA抗原を発現していた。X染色体陽性の頬粘膜細胞の割合(15%)は正常女性(20～25%)より低く、Y小体陽性の頬粘膜細胞の割合(10%)は正常女性(0～3%)より高かった。外科的に切除された腹部腫瘍は右子宮付属器で、悪性転化を伴っており、組織学的診断はディスジャーミノーマであった。腫瘍細胞巣および導管構造の上皮細胞はA抗原を発現し、血管の内皮細胞はB抗原を発現していた。これらの所見から、被検者の身体細胞は2つの細胞系統に由来することが示された。すなわち、A1遺伝子を有する系統は正常な46XY男性核型を、B遺伝子を有する系統は正常な46XX女性核型を有していた。また、前者の細胞系統が寄与した右性腺はY染色体の存在下で悪性腫瘍を生じていたことが示唆された。
